[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Nancy was born in 1836. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-539|Hugh Glasgow]] and [[Miller-37219|Margaret Miller]].  She passed away in 1861. 

Nancy's husband was John A. Donald.
